originality.rationale: The principal results are mathematically covered by the distinct published fibbinary progression census below, via an exact dyadic affine decomposition. No chronological priority between the two same-day records is inferred. To see the implication, write E for the no-adjacent-ones integers and E_r=E∩[0,2^r). The numbers whose 1-runs are all even are precisely 3m with m∈E: pair consecutive ones within each run from the low end, or use m+2m with no carry. For L≥2, complement the L-bit representation of n∈A. If the ignored padding has even length, all 1-runs in the complement are even, so n=2^L−1−3m with m∈E_{L−1}. If the padding has odd length, delete the most significant one of the complement (subtract 2^{L−1}); the remaining 1-runs are even, so n=2^{L−1}−1−3m with m∈E_{L−2}. Both converses hold; the convention at zero agrees. The two images are disjoint residue classes mod 3, so every 3- or 4-AP in their union stays in one image (otherwise the first three terms use all three residues), and reflection and scaling preserve APs. Thus T_L=A_{L−1}+A_{L−2} for the published census A_r of E. The levels L=0,1 are zero. The published GF and global four-term exclusion give both frozen claims, with length three attained already by the transferred E_2 triple (0,1,2) at L=3. The frozen dilation witness is the same triple (1,4,7) followed by the standard multiplication-by-four closure.
